nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael!
Some cross country runners from Wilson High walk past the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey girls! Nice skirts!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Um, thanks?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Too bad that's the only thing you Centerscore girls have going for you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Wilson High cheerleaders are way hotter.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoa, what?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: What can I say? The man speaks the truth.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You want a prize for biggest jerk? Because you're on the fast track to winning it.

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Come on, don't be a hater. Alexei `is` telling the truth.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, don't be a hater. Alexei [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Man, what's your problem? Way to disrespect cheerleaders everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We don't exist just to be eye candy for guys like you. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Sure you do! What else are cheerleaders good for?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, you asked for it!
Nicole winds up for a strong right hook!
Sierra has seen enough! She marches over to the Wilson High athletes.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That's enough!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But they insulted us! Let me fight 'em! I can take 'em, no problem!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Me too! I've been learning Aikido and Judo!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: We are not beating up the Wilson High guys, okay? We're not sinking to their level.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: We're not?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: We're better than that. We practice as a team for hours every week.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: We've gone to sectionals, regionals, and even state! We've sweated gallons, twisted ankles, and broken bones. We know we're athletes!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Right!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: These Wilson guys don't know `true` athletes when they see them!
nodes.text_bbcode: These Wilson guys don't know [color=#3b78e2][i]true[/i][/color] athletes when they see them!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: `We` know what we're worth! And you don't get to diss us just because you're sore about losing the track meet.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We[/i][/color] know what we're worth! And you don't get to diss us just because you're sore about losing the track meet.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, chill out... No need to get so touchy. Come on, Darren, let's get out of here.
Taylor steps out of the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girl, that was amazing! You really put those Wilson High guys in their place... And kept Sam and Jill from breaking a few noses.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Really? I was just telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I have to say... I was wrong about you. You've really got guts!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That's good, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're going to do great next year as Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yep. Come on, it's time for the closing ceremony. Lead the way, Sierra!
The cheerleaders wow the crowd with their gravity-defying stunts and synchronized cheers....
But $Michael notices that Sierra's phone is almost out of battery!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh no!
After the performance, $Michael rushes up to Sierra to tell her the bad news.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You were amazing out there! But... I didn't manage to record the whole thing.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh no! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Your phone ran out of juice...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, that's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It's okay...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, but next year you'll be Head Cheerleader. You'll have plenty of chances to record something for your mom.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You're right... There's always next time.
$Michael spots a familiar face in the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sierra! I see your dad...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What? Where?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Over there, by the bleachers.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It `is` him! I thought he was visiting the hospital today! And he's with... He's with...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] him! I thought he was visiting the hospital today! And he's with... He's with...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: `Mom!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mom![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I... I can't believe this. The doctors said she wouldn't be out for another year!
$Michael and Sierra run over to greet her mother. Mr. Seiler wheels Mrs. Seiler over in a wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Mom! How...?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: I was released early. I've been doing a lot better, but I didn't want to tell you and get your hopes up if the doctors were wrong...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: That's so great! Did you see?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: I saw your routine. I watched the whole thing.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What... what did you think? It's my first time leading.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: I know. Your father told me. I'm so proud of you.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: You looked just like your mother did when she was Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: Watching your performance made me feel like I was in high school again.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: You might even be a better Head Cheerleader than she was!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't go that far. But you were pretty great out there.
Sierra and her mother hug, with tears in their eyes.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Seiler
nodes.text: Okay, honey. We'll let you go say hi to your younger, more hip friends.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Seiler
nodes.text: See you at home, sweetie.
Sierra's parents leave to go home.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thank you so much, $Michael. I couldn't have done this without you...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Nah, that was all you.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But you helped me make my dream come true.
Sierra takes a step closer to $Michael...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You've always been there for me, even from day one...
Another step...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: ...When I couldn't even open my locker.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: To right now...
And another step...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: ...When I needed you the most.
She tilts her head up to him...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'll always be here for you.
$Michael leans down, pulling Sierra in for a passionate, electric kiss!
And the noise of the crowd fades away, so that all that's left is the two of them... Together.
You have reached the end of `Sierra's Challenge!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Sierra's Challenge![/b]

nodes.text: Thanks for playing!
She knows she's failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Good luck! I know you're going to kick butt.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm so pumped! I'll prove to Taylor once and for all that I'm fit to be Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: To do well, you've got to be confident! Remember what I said? Stand up straight, take deep breaths...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You don't think I can do this, do you...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No, I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Me neither... I'm so nervous!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But... But you've got this! Don't worry!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I feel like I've got butterflies in my stomach, and they're going to migrate up my esophagus...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, calm down...
Sierra takes a few deep breaths.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Okay, I can do this.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's what I thought. Sierra, you really need to learn how to stand up for yourself!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just did something very unfair to you and the other cheerleaders... And you didn't do a thing!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But... You said...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you can't stand up to me, then how will you stand up for your team? You've got to have their backs!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I don't think you're fit to be Head Cheerleader. Jill!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Congratulations, you're the next Head Cheerleader. Sorry, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: It's okay. I understand...
Sierra leaves to find $Michael as all the girls congratulate Jill.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That was harsh... I'm so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But I deserved it. Taylor's right.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Maybe I could have been a great Head Cheerleader... But I guess I'll never know...
Sierra walks sadly away, knowing in her heart...
Sierra takes a deep breath, stands up very straight, and says...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I understand where you're coming from...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But this really isn't fair!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: My team should get pom-poms, too! It's the only way we can show proper team spirit and, uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Maximize our cheer potential!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! What she said!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: This isn't fair to me, or the rest of the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, okay. You got me. I was testing you... And you passed!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wanted to see if you could stand up for yourself and your team.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every Head Cheerleader needs to lead, as well as listen. You've got to be there for your team.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You stood up for your cheerleaders, and they backed you up. That's what I like to see!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Congrats on growing a backbone, girl.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now let's get this cheer-off started!
Jill and Sierra do their best at the cheer-off...
But a clear winner emerges!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, that was an amazing routine. The synchronization... The flips... And that split lift!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, it's all thanks to the amazing cheerleaders that backed me up.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Don't get ahead of yourself. It wasn't perfect... Your moves could be more defined.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But not bad, Sierra, not bad...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls, meet your new Head Cheerleader, Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sierra, you're in charge of the closing ceremony performance after the track meet. You think you can handle it?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If not, Jill's next in line for Head Cheerleader. And I don't do second chances.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hope you're not the sort to crack under pressure.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Uh... I think I can do it!
A week later...
$Michael stretches on the track with Dex. Runners from the Wilson High track team warm up across the field. The bleachers are filling up with spectators!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You ready for this relay race?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ready as I'll ever be...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What's wrong? You look sort of wound up.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... I'm just worried about the closing ceremony. It's Sierra's first time leading the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Chill, man. You've got to stay focused on this race. Right now is no time for stressing.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You're right. I should believe in Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Channel all that stress into becoming a cheetah. You are now the swiftest creature in the savannah, chasing down injured gazelles and feasting on their flesh!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoa. So what are you?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm a hippo, menace of the swamplands! Despite my stocky frame and short legs, I can run up to 30 kilometers per hour.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, sure you can.
$Michael's race rolls around...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay... I can do this!
$Michael leaps off the starting block, quickly finding himself tied for the lead!
Hurdle after hurdle, $Michael races to keep up with the other hurdler...
$Michael pulls ahead in the final stretch and wins the race!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I've never seen you jump the hurdles so fast! That was incredible.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I just pretended that I was a cheetah on the savannah...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, it worked! Congrats.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, can you record my performance on my phone? I want to show my mom later when I visit the hospital.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure! No problem...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But it's so hard to make the girls listen to me. I'll never make a good Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: No way! You can do it! I believe in you.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Of course. You just need some confidence! You know, stand up straight, take deep breaths, and speak with authority.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: And that's going to work?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It works when I'm dealing with my little sister. Oh, here's one trick... Instead of saying 'I understand,' say 'I understand where you're coming from, but...' That little change in phrasing will set you up for being assertive!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Okay, I'll try that.
After the pep talk, Sierra returns to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Everyone done getting water? Let's run through our sectionals routine for warm-up.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Meh.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This heat is making me as sleepy as a baby sloth.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I understand where you guys are coming from... It `is` hot...
nodes.text_bbcode: I understand where you guys are coming from... It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] hot...

nodes.text: Sierra looks to $Michael who nods encouragingly.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: `But` we still need to practice. We can totally move this to the shade...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But[/i][/color] we still need to practice. We can totally move this to the shade...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The shade sounds nice...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: And maybe if we really rock this routine, we can get ice cream afterwards! I hear Sundae Morning just opened up... It'll be my treat!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I `have` been craving chocolate ice cream...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] been craving chocolate ice cream...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And I hear the cashier at Sundae Morning is mega hot. Let's get this practice over with!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Everyone, get into formation!
Cheer practice goes off without a hitch!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whew! That was pretty fun!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I have to admit, that was a great workout.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And our routine looks fantastic. I think I've finally got that one lift locked!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Ready for ice cream?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Cold ice cream and hot guys? Yes!
The cheerleaders go out to get ice cream at Sundae Morning.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, $Michael! Can you take a picture of us with my phone?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I want to immortalize this beautiful banana split for all eternity.
$Michael takes the picture.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How's this?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Fantastic! My mom's going to love this picture of me with my team.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Great! I can't wait to show my mom!
You are now playing as Sierra.
It's the day of the cheer-off!
$Michael and his track team drop by after practice to watch.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A cheer-off, huh? How's that work?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Let me guess. It's a cheerleading competition... To the DEATH! A heroic fight for supremacy, with only one victor!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Not quite. Sierra and Jill are showing Taylor who's best suited for Head Cheerleader next year.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But metaphorically, it's a bloody battle over the iron, er, pom-pom throne.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You think your girlfriend's going to win?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't know... I hope so.
The cheerleaders are ready for the cheer-off!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Alright, girls. Whoever has the best routine and displays the strongest leadership is the next Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoo! Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course, I make the final decision here. This ain't a democracy.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, no hard feelings, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Thanks... Not that I need it. But good luck to you, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks! Not that I need it, either.
Taylor tosses some pom-poms to Jill.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here, Jill, you can use these.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um, where are our pom-poms?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't get any. I want to see how well your team performs the routine without pom-poms.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No buts! Come on, show me what you got!

nodes.prompt: Help Sierra remember what to do!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You're being a pushover.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Remember what Taylor said?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: She thinks I don't have the guts to lead...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, it wouldn't hurt to be more assertive.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But how?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Stand up for yourself! Show 'em who's boss!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You might want to, uh, change tactics...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hm? Why?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You... You're being a little... Um...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael, what are you trying to say?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Maybe you should, uh, assert yourself a little more?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You think I'm being a pushover. Why didn't you just say so?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Well, I didn't want to hurt your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'm not a porcelain doll, $Michael. I can take constructive criticism.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Fine! I'll say it! I think you're being a pushover!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't want to hurt her feelings, but Sierra's being pushed around a lot. What should I say?

options.label: You might want to, uh, change tactics...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Girls, you heard Sierra. Get stretching!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I had it covered!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Didn't look like it to me...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, I don't need your help, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: But...
Jessica clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sierra? Do we still have to practice?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yes, but... Uh, just take a water break.
As the girls get water, Sierra watches them sadly.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry for butting in like that, but... Can I talk to you for a sec?
$Michael stops himself from chiming in and waits to see what happens.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Okay, no stretching. How about we, uh, start on our sectionals routine?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do we have to?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: My mascara is starting to melt in this heat. I didn't even know that was possible!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I understand... Um, okay, let's just, uh, take a quick water break!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sweet! I love water. It's, like, liquid and stuff.
$Michael walks up to Sierra as the other girls grab their water bottles.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You okay? Looks like things are getting a little out of hand.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm handling it.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Stay strong! You can do it.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks for, you know, not jumping in.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, I believe in you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I know Taylor has her doubts, but it means a lot to me that `you` trust me enough to do this on my own.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know Taylor has her doubts, but it means a lot to me that [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] trust me enough to do this on my own.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Can I talk to you for a sec?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What I mean is... Sierra does tend to back down, but not when it really matters. And everyone loves her. She'd make a great Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I don't know about that.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She'll always stand up for the other cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Really?` You think so?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Really?[/i][/color] You think so?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I know it! You said it yourself... You respect her for standing up to you! And all the other cheerleaders backed her up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She's got real potential as a leader. Don't you want to help her realize it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine, fine. How about this... I'll hold a cheer-off.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How's that work?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jill and Sierra are my top two candidates for the next Head Cheerleader. They can face off against each other. Whoever displays the best leadership and puts together the most coordinated routine gets to be the next Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sounds like a plan.
Taylor and $Michael walk to their next class...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I just wanted to say... Thanks for giving Sierra a chance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just want what's best for my team. Sierra better be ready!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You can bet on it!
The next day, $Michael accompanies Sierra to the football field.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks for coming with me, $Michael.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: The cheer-off's only a few days away, and I'm going to need that time to get my half of the squad ready for it!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll do great.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I hope so... I just wish it weren't so hot today...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh! The girls are here! Wish me luck!
As the cheerleaders join Sierra, $Michael sits on the bleachers to watch.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Okay, girls! For warm-up, let's practice our handsprings and flips.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's `so` hot... Instead of doing flips, why don't we relax in the shade?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot... Instead of doing flips, why don't we relax in the shade?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, it's, like, a million degrees right now!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I understand... How about we stretch?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You mean like... Stretch out by the pool?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: O.M.G... That's a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Uh, I meant... Stretching our muscles before cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sierra, it's way too hot for cheerleading practice! We should be lounging by the pool with iced drinks...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...And checking out the cute lifeguards!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That sounds like heaven.
Meanwhile, Jill's cheer practice across the field is going smoothly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow! Did you see that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Jill's on the top of the pyramid over there!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I didn't even know pyramids went that high.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Uh, girls? What about stretching?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Way. Too. Hot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Watching Jill and the others is making `me` sweat!
nodes.text_bbcode: Watching Jill and the others is making [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] sweat!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sierra's getting pushed around by the cheerleaders! Maybe I should step in...
$Michael jumps off the bleachers.
Taylor nods thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hadn't thought of it that way...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She's tough when she needs to be.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Don't you mean a wolf in sheep's clothing?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, what you said.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, Sierra's really a sheep!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I mean, a wolf! A tough, cheerleading wolf! Wait, that didn't come out right.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So this has nothing to do with the Kiss and Make Up Dance?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course not! When Sierra stood up to me at the dance... She showed that she had guts!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I hadn't thought of it that way...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In fact, I respect Sierra for defying me at the dance.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What happened at the dance is the only reason I'm even considering her as my successor.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But since the dance, I haven't seen Sierra stand up for herself even once! Being Head Cheerleader means having the courage to lead and support your team.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I seriously doubt Sierra has what it takes.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She does!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If Sierra doesn't have the guts to stand up for herself and her team, then she isn't fit to be Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Come on, Taylor. Give Sierra a chance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A Head Cheerleader needs to be tough. I need wolves. Sierra's a sheep!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sierra's really a...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, what do you think of Sierra?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sierra? She's a great cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, she says you're pretty amazing, too... Great at leading the squad...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait a second... I know what this is about.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sierra's not sure I'll pick her for Head Cheerleader! And she roped `you` into scoping out the situation!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sierra's not sure I'll pick her for Head Cheerleader! And she roped [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] into scoping out the situation!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Well, when you put it that way...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why didn't she just ask me herself?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See, this is my problem with Sierra. Even for something like this, she hides behind her `boyfriend`!
nodes.text_bbcode: See, this is my problem with Sierra. Even for something like this, she hides behind her [color=#3b78e2][i]boyfriend[/i][/color]!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: She doesn't take initiative. She doesn't speak up for herself. Obviously, I have my doubts about her.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Who are you thinking of for Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Huh! Direct and to the point. Jill or Sierra, since you asked.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So which one are you leaning towards?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sierra's a great cheerleader, but I have my doubts about her.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What's to doubt?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See? That's what I want to see from Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're upfront and direct. That's the sort of confidence I want to see in my cheerleaders. And, well, Sierra...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She's not the most assertive girl around...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly! So I'm not sure she has what it takes to be Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'll have a Saloon Stew.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And I'll have a plate of Buckaroo Biscuits with a side of Blasted Beans.
Tex saunters off with the orders.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What is up with that waiter? Sierra, he totally dissed cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, but I understand what he means...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What does Tex know about cheerleading? Sierra, it's okay to stand up for yourself sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I guess, but it's just so hard! I'm a people-pleaser! Not a people, uh, fighter. I like making people happy, not hurting their feelings.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: And that's what I love about you! But it doesn't hurt to assert yourself sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You're right... Hey, speaking of asserting oneself...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Do you think you could talk to Taylor for me? Maybe find out how she's feeling about making me Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Why me? You could talk to her, too.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You're a big shot team captain now! She'll listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I'll try.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks, $Michael. Have I ever told you what a great boyfriend you are?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Who, me? We're dating?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Joking, joking.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, let's take a selfie. Here, hold my phone.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: One... Two... Three... `Cheese!`
nodes.text_bbcode: One... Two... Three... [color=#e23b3b][i]Cheese![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Okay, now take another one with me and my plate.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: One... Two... Three...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Cheese! Got the shot?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It looks good. Are you going to show this to your mom?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: By the way, how is she doing?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: She's... Not doing so well. The doctor said that she'll be in the hospital for a while.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You can show her your pictures the next time you visit.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, this picture looks great!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: `You` look great.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] look great.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw thanks, $Michael.
Sierra leans in and kisses $Michael sweetly!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Happy anniversary!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Happy anniversary!
The next day at school, $Michael catches Taylor between classes.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey $Michael. How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Haven't talked to you in a while. You ready to graduate?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I am `so` ready. I've got a bad case of senioritis.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] ready. I've got a bad case of senioritis.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, I can't wait for summer break!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Me neither!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Speaking of the end of the year... We'll really miss you when you graduate.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll really miss Centerscore High... And the cheerleading squad, too... It's going to be strange not being Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Here's my chance to bring up Sierra being Head Cheerleader... But how do I do it?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She's an amazing athlete, too! Cheerleading's a really intense sport.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, $Michael. You're making me blush.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She works really hard at what she does.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Is that so?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Yeah, she practices for hours every day. What she does is like gymnastics, dance, and track all rolled into one. It's incredible.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Huh, maybe I should give her the full 20% off!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Wow, really?

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Sure, honey. What'll you have?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: She's really cute!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: You betcha.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: $Michael, I'm right here.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What? You `are` cute.
nodes.text_bbcode: What? You [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] cute.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What does that have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It means that you, uh, deserve the full 20%, just like the rest of us!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Really, $Michael? I'm not `just` cute.
nodes.text_bbcode: Really, $Michael? I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] cute.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Right... You're much more than that.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: So... What'll you have?
A waiter steps to the table. Looking up, $Michael sees a familiar face!
It's Tex from Western World!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Howdy! I'll be your waiter for... Oh, look here! I remember you guys!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, Tex!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: I'm sure glad y'all escaped the clutches of the Red Bandit! Y'all ready to order? Our cowboy burgers are real delicious. Guaranteed 0% cowboy, 100% meat.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, what a relief.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Give us a minute.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Sure thing. Y'all give me a holler when you're ready.
Tex leaves, leather boots clicking on the tiles.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I wasn't expecting to see him.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Me neither.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: It's been, what, nearly a year since all that happened? We went on that horseback ride...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: The Kiss and Make Up Dance...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: So many things have changed since then... I'm captain of the track team and you're a popular cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: And Taylor's graduating this year! She's going to appoint the next Head Cheerleader soon.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey, that's always been your dream! To be the most popular girl in school and lead the cheerleading squad...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yep, but...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You don't think you'll make Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Actually, no, I don't think Taylor likes me very much...

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: What? But all the cheerleaders love you! Who else would be Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Jill's the strongest candidate... She's athletic and tough!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Jill, huh.. Yeah, I've seen her do clapping push-ups.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Besides, I think Taylor still holds a grudge for what I did at the Kiss and Make Up dance. You know, when I went to the dance with you and not Zach.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: That's not fair! You did the right thing!
Tex stops by the table.

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Stick 'em up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: ...Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Y'all ready to order? There's a real special discount this week for high school athletes.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I'm captain of the track team!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Okay, 20% off for you!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: And I'm a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Oh, honey. That's not a real sport.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But it is!

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: Naw, cheerleading's just hopping around in a skirt.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure it's a sport...

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: But cheerleaders ain't real athletes, like in other sports.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: You see what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I guess I understand...

nodes.speaker: Tex
nodes.text: But I'll give you 10% off just for being cute.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Hey! She's not just `cute`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! She's not just [color=#e23b3b][i]cute[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: Sierra and $Michael clink glasses.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sierra, this whole year with you has been... Magical.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Aw, I feel the same way.
Sierra puts her glass down.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What? That doesn't even make sense.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, well, I thought it would be funny. Guess I'm not that good at toasts.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, let me help you.
Sierra holds up her glass.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: To our future!
Sierra and $Michael clink glasses.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: To, uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: To what, $Michael?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Free refills of water?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, I thought you were going to say something a little more... Romantic.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: How about... To us?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: To us.
Welcome to a Battle of the Schools short story!
We'll start by having you choose a look for your character, $Michael.
And now...
You are now playing as $Michael.
Six months have passed since the Kiss and Make Up Dance!
$Michael and Sierra are eating a candlelit dinner at the Wild West restaurant, Cowboy Burger.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Can you believe it? We've been dating for six months.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Wow! That long?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Time flies when you're in love! Which is why I propose a toast!
$Michael raises his water glass, and Sierra does the same.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: With glasses of... Water?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Here's to...
A week later...
$Michael stretches on the track with Dex. Runners from the Wilson High track team warm up across the field. The bleachers are filling up with spectators!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You ready for this relay race?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Ready as I'll ever be...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What's wrong? You look sort of wound up.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I... I'm just worried about the closing ceremony. It's Sierra's first time leading the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Chill, man. You've got to stay focused on this race. Right now is no time for stressing.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: You're right. I should believe in Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Channel all that stress into becoming a cheetah. You are now the swiftest creature in the savannah, chasing down injured gazelles and feasting on their flesh!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Whoa. So what are you?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I'm a hippo, menace of the swamplands! Despite my stocky frame and short legs, I can run up to 30 kilometers per hour.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh, sure you can.
$Michael's race rolls around...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're up!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Okay... I can do this!
$Michael leaps off the starting block, quickly finding himself tied for the lead!
Hurdle after hurdle, $Michael races to keep up with the other hurdler...
$Michael pulls ahead in the final stretch and wins the race!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I've never seen you jump the hurdles so fast! That was incredible.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I just pretended that I was a cheetah on the savannah...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, it worked! Congrats.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Hey, can you record my performance on my phone? I want to show my mom later when I visit the hospital.

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Sure! No problem...
Sierra takes a deep breath, stands up very straight, and says...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: I understand where you're coming from...

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But this really isn't fair!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: My team should get pom-poms, too! It's the only way we can show proper team spirit and, uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Maximize our cheer potential!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah! What she said!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: This isn't fair to me, or the rest of the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, okay. You got me. I was testing you... And you passed!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wanted to see if you could stand up for yourself and your team.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every Head Cheerleader needs to lead, as well as listen. You've got to be there for your team.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You stood up for your cheerleaders, and they backed you up. That's what I like to see!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Congrats on growing a backbone, girl.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now let's get this cheer-off started!
Jill and Sierra do their best at the cheer-off...
But a clear winner emerges!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, that was an amazing routine. The synchronization... The flips... And that split lift!

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Well, it's all thanks to the amazing cheerleaders that backed me up.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Don't get ahead of yourself. It wasn't perfect... Your moves could be more defined.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But not bad, Sierra, not bad...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls, meet your new Head Cheerleader, Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go Sierra!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sierra, you're in charge of the closing ceremony performance after the track meet. You think you can handle it?

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If not, Jill's next in line for Head Cheerleader. And I don't do second chances.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Oh, right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hope you're not the sort to crack under pressure.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Uh... I think I can do it!
She knows she's failed.

nodes.text: You are now playing as Sierra.
It's the day of the cheer-off!
$Michael and his track team drop by after practice to watch.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: A cheer-off, huh? How's that work?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Let me guess. It's a cheerleading competition... To the DEATH! A heroic fight for supremacy, with only one victor!

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: Not quite. Sierra and Jill are showing Taylor who's best suited for Head Cheerleader next year.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But metaphorically, it's a bloody battle over the iron, er, pom-pom throne.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You think your girlfriend's going to win?

nodes.speaker: Michael
nodes.text: I don't know... I hope so.
The cheerleaders are ready for the cheer-off!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Alright, girls. Whoever has the best routine and displays the strongest leadership is the next Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoo! Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course, I make the final decision here. This ain't a democracy.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey, no hard feelings, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Thanks... Not that I need it. But good luck to you, Sierra.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Thanks! Not that I need it, either.
Taylor tosses some pom-poms to Jill.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Here, Jill, you can use these.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: Um, where are our pom-poms?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You don't get any. I want to see how well your team performs the routine without pom-poms.

nodes.speaker: Sierra
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No buts! Come on, show me what you got!

You have unlocked the Bonus Scene! Enjoy!
$Michael rings the doorbell to Sierra's house!
Oh, just some buttermilk biscuits I baked earlier.
Ever since the bake sale. I was inspired by those glorious confections of culinary delight!
You've been watching too much of the cooking channel.
Those chefs look so sharp in an apron! I can't tear my eyes away.
Well, you look pretty sharp yourself!
You think? That's a relief. I wanted to look my best for your parents.

Oh, $Michael, don't worry about it. Come on in.
$Michael and Sierra walk into the dining room.
Oh, my favorite! It'll be perfect with what I've made. Let's eat!
$Michael sits down for a cozy dinner with Sierra's family!
